[All chieftainships throughout the North-west Coast Agency are hereditary, and the heir to a chieftainship is
considered a chief from his birth, but he requires to make a potlach before succeeding to the powers of a chieftain.
Second chieftainships are more family headships than tribal chiefs.] [(t)Many chiefs as well as others have dropped
their Indian names and hold only the names of white people given them by missionaries.] 14 - 38
